parameters.name: hgt
parameters.type: ∀ (m : TargetMachine) (lt rt : NumberTag), binaryValue BalancePrograms.balancePyProgram.lang m .gt (.number lt n) (.number rt 0) = .ok (.ok (.bool (decide (0 < n))))

parameters.name: hfloat
parameters.type: ∀ (m : TargetMachine) (tag : NumberTag), hostCall .python m .float none [.number tag n] = .ok ⟨m, .ok (.number .pyFloat n)⟩

parameters.name: hzero
parameters.type: ∀ (m : TargetMachine) (tag : NumberTag), hostCall .python m .float none [.number tag 0] = .ok ⟨m, .ok (.number .pyFloat 0)⟩
